examples.english: Just as in years prior, more than 15 professional events were developed, there has been discussion about Eduardo Heras León, for the 500th anniversary of the founding of the Village of San Cristóbal of Havana, Matanzas, about Human Health and the Natural Environment, and of the Social Sciences; furthermore of the meeting of historians, creators of child and young adult Literature, of editors and translators, of librarians and library scientists.
examples.ref: 2019 January 30, Ricardo Alonso Venereo, “La literatura invita”, in Granma:
examples.text: Como en años anteriores se desarrollarán más de 15 eventos profesionales, entre ellos los coloquios sobre Eduardo Heras León, por el aniversario 500 de la fundación de la Villa de San Cristóbal de La Habana, Martiano, sobre Salud Humana y Medio Ambiente, y el de Ciencias Sociales; además de los encuentros de historiadores, de creadores de Literatura infantil y juvenil, de editores y traductores, de libreros y el científico bibliotecológico.
examples.translation: Just as in years prior, more than 15 professional events were developed, there has been discussion about Eduardo Heras León, for the 500th anniversary of the founding of the Village of San Cristóbal of Havana, Matanzas, about Human Health and the Natural Environment, and of the Social Sciences; furthermore of the meeting of historians, creators of child and young adult Literature, of editors and translators, of librarians and library scientists.
